title: Events
content:
*  March 30th, 2021 - 18.00pm - Conversation with legalization campaigns across Europe. Fighting together!

*  February 24, 2021 - Protest for the right to education.

*  January 28, 2021 - Pressconference on the situation of people without papers in the 2nd lockdown.

*  December 18, 2020 - Artistic intervention at different locations in Berlin. Against paragraph 87 and the criminalization of undocumented people.

*  November 21, 2020 - Perreo Combativo. Combative dance for the visibility and legalization of people without papers.

*  October 12, 2020 - Press conference. Launch of the campaign Legalisierung Jetzt.
content2:
* April, 24th - 2pm - Close the gap – legalization NOW! Protest demo starting at Weltzeituhr Alexanderplatz to the Innensenat (Klosterstr.47).One year ago we went public with the demand Legalisierung Jetzt! for the rights of undocumented people in Berlin in times of Covid 19, whose already precarious situation drastically deteriorated in times of the pandemic. 

   We are here, we are many and we are loud!
